name: Katsuragi
text: Katsuragi (かつらぎ町, Katsuragi-chō) is a town located in Ito District, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. As of 30 November 2021, the town had an estimated population of 16,170 in 7137 households and a population density of 110 persons per km2. The total area of the town is 151.69 square kilometres (58.57 sq mi).

depictions.name: Katsuragi
depictions.text: Katsuragi, Nara Katsuragi is a city in Nara Prefecture, Japan, formerly part of the Yamato province.
